objectives.description: Selection flags --milestone/--batch/--tasks, --stack-id (required for batch/tasks, defaulted from milestone)
Read each task's landing proof via batch_admission_record_for_task (PD10): commits, end_commit, paths, shared_paths
Fallback attribution for a task with no proof: commit-subject convention bounded by created time; refuse by name when neither
Build units per PD3 (shared_paths merge, --merge N+M)
Detect an earlier unmerged task touching a selected unit's paths; pull in or refuse
Order per PD5: components (dependency edges + path overlap), topological order, ancestry tie-break, contradiction refusal, --order override
Assign each unit its branch name and base (parent unit's branch, or review base for the bottom of each component)

Suite cases: three dependent tasks order bottom-up; path-disjoint tasks follow the edge against landing order; path-overlapping tasks against landing order refused; shared_paths pair becomes one unit; no-proof task attributed and marked; two components yield two stacks each bottomed on the review base

approaches_tried.approach: resolve cut's selection (--milestone/--batch/--tasks) before review_base/remote/platform, refusing immediately when none is given
approaches_tried.reason: broke every Phase 1 success-path assertion that calls `cut --dry-run` with no selection at all to exercise the shared resolver chain; split into a non-refusing rsp_gather_selection (runs first, so integration-branch resolution can use the selected tasks) and a separate rsp_validate_selection (runs after review_base/remote/platform, inside cut's own body), and repointed the 5 Phase-1 success-path assertions that were really testing the shared resolvers at `show` instead of `cut`, since `show`'s body is still the Phase 1 placeholder
